rule.mean_selection: Choose v35 or v36 with lowest equal-study squared LFC error on the44 frozen raw cases, among candidates passing count noninferiority guards if any. If none pass, package the lowest-mean-error candidate as exploratory only. Never change the V24 champion record.
rule.dispersion_selection: For a selected v36 mean, adopt its dispersion arm only if it passes all count guards and improves at least2 of FID,REACH,JAC,NMAE with no expression-error regression versus the unchanged-emitter v36 arm. Otherwise unchanged V24 emitter.

guards.null_DE_calls: no more than matched V24 for every context

rule.reserve: Never open D3 for exploratory packaging; no blind improvement claim.
rule.submission: Prepare validated upload package; no automatic upload, existing packages unchanged.
